commits.message:
feat(review): signature field CRUD, per-domain pattern learning, and a publish gate

Hermes is now the staging layer in front of the live Jobfynder Core job
board -- a draft's job requirement/hotlist fields already had Update-only
CRUD (HERMES-950), but the sender-signature fields (name/email/company/
title, deterministically extracted from the email's own signature block
-- app/email_parsing/signature.py) had none: a reviewer could see them
but never fix a wrong one. And nothing stopped a draft that still needed
review, with no job title at all, from being published straight through
to the live site.

Three additive pieces:

- Signature CRUD: apply_field_corrections(record_type="signature", ...)
  (app/drafts/service.py) edits a signature contact field in place, same
  audit trail as job_requirement/hotlist corrections. Only a field the
  parser actually detected on this draft is editable -- no injecting
  keys the parser doesn't produce, since signature.contact isn't a fixed
  schema. Wired into the "Detected signature" card on the review page
  with the same inline-edit FieldRow already used elsewhere.

- Per-sender-domain pattern learning (app/email_parsing/
  signature_learning.py, new signature_corrections table): every
  signature correction is remembered per sender domain. The next email
  from that domain gets the same gap filled in automatically --
  gap-filling only, never overriding a value the deterministic parser
  did manage to extract, so a domain with genuinely different recruiters
  never gets one person's corrected value stamped onto another's email.

- Publish gate (_publish_block_reason in app/drafts/service.py):
  publish_draft_object now refuses a draft_job_requirement that's still
  requires_review with no job title at all, returning status="blocked"
  instead of pushing a blank/broken posting to Core. Deliberately
  narrow -- doesn't gate on requires_review alone, doesn't touch any
  other draft type, and a reviewer who's actually looked at a
  requires_review draft can still publish it normally.

New coverage: signature field edits persist and are stamped
human_edited; an undetected field can't be injected via a correction;
a learned pattern fills a real gap on the next email from the same
domain but never overrides a value the parser found; the publish gate
blocks the no-title case, allows everything else, and leaves non-
job_requirement drafts untouched. Full regression suite (18 checks)
green against a fresh schema and rebuilt image; frontend type-checks
and builds clean.
